caption: A sheet of paper is fed into a shredder, and it comes out the bottom as a bundle of thin strips.

sa.check: A sheet of paper is fed into the top of a shredder.
Strips come out of the bottom.
The sheet goes in first and the strips come out after.

pc.expect: The sheet is drawn in at the top and strips emerge below as it passes.
pc.fail: Strips emerge before the sheet enters; or the sheet goes in and nothing comes out; or strips come out the top.

pc.expect: The sheet does not reappear whole and the strips are from that sheet.
pc.fail: The sheet is whole again; or strips appear from nowhere; or the sheet vanishes with no strips.
They rise; or float; or stand out rigidly.
They are rigid; or melt; or tear randomly.
It duplicates; or turns into another object; or the paper merges with it.

pc.expect: The shredder and the paper stay the same.
pc.fail: The shredder changes; or the paper changes colour; or the room rearranges.
